title: Advertisement for the Post of Graphics Animator
text:
KEY LINES:
a) Qualification:
Educational Qualification (Please attach one set of attested copies)

FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research Project
entitled “Community Environmental Empowerment Program (CEEP)”. Posts are purely on contract basis
and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Graphics Animator
a) Qualification:
Essential: 12th pass having working experience in 2 D/3D Animation/Graphics design
Or
Diploma or Degree in Animation/Graphics/ Design/ allied discipline
Desirable: Knowledge of Adobe Flash, Animate CC, 3DsMax, 3D Maya, Toon Boom Harmony and
Adobe premiere pro.
2D software
 Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
b) Salary: Rs. 40000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description:
 A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having good knowledge
of Graphic Design Skills, brainstorming creative designing ideas, Good interpersonal skills,
Ability to Work in Strict Deadlines, Researching and preparing rough drafts.
 Developing and designing layouts, concepts, graphics for company logos, product illustrations
and websites, suggesting improvements after reviewing final layouts
 Able to understand brief provided and create high quality visual within given timelines
Applications along with bio-data, copies of certificates and work experience along with copy of work undertaken
should reach to the undersigned latest by 19 July 2023 before 4.00 pm at email puevs@pu.ac.in
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/mPdDgXQ8B8gFXknh8 before submitting
application with document through email. Application will not be considered if google form is not filled.
The interview date and time will be informed through email to shortlisted candidates. Interview may be held
online/offline. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab
University and/or funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Principle Investigator E.mail: puevs@pu.ac.in
